provenance.construction: One-qubit Clifford reduction of the board entry codes/800-8-27.json, whose weight-8 B=3 tile construction, open directional boundary, single-layer rotated-square layout, and distance witnesses are credited to @MicheldeMessieres and the earlier tile family credited there. Use the X stabilizer S = source X row 0 with support T={2,400,401}; clear source qubit a=400 from the only other X row meeting it (row 18) by R_18 <- R_18 + S. Apply CNOT fan-out from a=400 to T\{a}={2,401}. This maps S to the weight-one stabilizer X_400 and maps column 400 of H_Z to zero by CSS commutation. Delete X_400 and qubit 400, then renumber every surviving source qubit q>400 as q-1. The operation is a Clifford equivalence followed by removal of a disentangled qubit, so k remains 8. Surviving qubits retain the source coordinates; measured interaction radius remains 4.0 with one qubit per site.
provenance.notes: Derivative contribution, not an independent tile construction. The source [[800,8,d<=27]] code, layout, and weight-27 X/Z witnesses are credited to @MicheldeMessieres; this contribution is the explicit one-qubit stabilizer reduction to n=799. Both source witnesses avoid qubit 400 and transform to valid weight-27 witnesses after renumbering. The current official verifier recomputes k=8, max check weight 8, single-layer locality, and interaction radius 4.0. Two independent CI-style local fire passes used seeds 2026101001 and 2027101004. Each pass ran the structural gate, the 50000-trial orbit-fold gate, 120880 ordinary RIS trials, and 8000000 RIS-fast trials. Neither pass found a logical below weight 27; the lightest observed weight was 27. Total post-reduction search: 16241760 RIS trials. Distance remains a witness-backed upper bound, not an exact-distance claim.
